human_figures.description: Four complete clothed human figures occupy cardinal sectors. Heads lie outside the outer circular band; legs and feet point toward the central gold disc. Their hands flank or touch the ring. Top wears a broad hat, right a decorated/crowned head covering, bottom a hood, left a pointed hood. Their faces are presented toward the viewer; the figures rotate with their sectors.
human_figures.orientation_caution: Head-position/body-axis inwardness is different from gaze direction. The heads are outside and feet inside; I cannot assign a precise three-dimensional gaze.

inscription_registers.count_interpretation: Four external head labels; one circumferential band with numerous short red labels (apparently zodiac names); four inscribed diagonal spokes. The two prose columns and red caption above are separate page text, not further fourfold diagram registers.
inscription_registers.fourfold_figure_adjacent_description: One red outlined rectangular label immediately beyond each head. Each is spatially unique to that figure.
inscription_registers.fourfold_offset_description: Four narrow inscribed white radial bars occur between cardinal figure sectors, at approximately NW, NE, SE and SW. Each runs from the hub to the outer circular band and separates two differently coloured sectors.
inscription_registers.outer_annulus: The annular red lettering is subdivided into more than four items. Clearly visible strings include gemini, aquaris, peiss(es/o?) and taurus-like forms; not diplomatically collated. It must not be compressed into four labels merely to match the question.

figure_labels.note: Season-name interpretation supported by supplied catalogue; spelling tentative.
Initial letter and u/v diplomatic distinction uncertain.
Rotated lettering; do not use this spelling as a fixed literal key.

readings.offset_labels: All four spokes carry actual multi-character inscriptions. They appear to be short date-like expressions, with numeral-looking openings and ion/...? segments. I do not confidently recover every word or numeral at this display and do not fill values from expected solstices/equinoxes. No complete four-value diplomatic register certified.

ownership.device_description: Closed head-label boxes, circular sector band, four radial divider bars and central disc are explicit drawn devices. Head labels have unambiguous nearest-head assignment. Spokes visibly separate adjacent figure sectors.
ownership.description: No connector assigns each interfigure spoke label to exactly one of its two flanking figure/head-label sectors. The bars are shared boundaries. A start/end convention could give a mapping, but that convention is not independently read here. Sector co-membership of the annular text differs from one-to-one ownership of a boundary label.

source_to_target_start_orientation.description: The source has a fixed upright page and four readable seasonal head labels, but no Voynich target was inspected and no shared marker establishes a target start, rotation or reflection. Do not rotate to fit.

claim_limit: The source genuinely supplies four seasonal personifications and four offset inscribed divider spokes, plus a separate multi-item annulus. Complete readable paired-register ownership is not certified. This is not a Voynich reading or a general refutation of seasonal content.
